name: Jainam Ferro Alloys (India) Ltd.
summary: Jainam Ferro Alloys (India) Ltd. is an India-based manufacturer and exporter primarily focused on ferro alloys. The company produces manganese-based alloys such as Ferro Manganese and Silico Manganese, which are essential additives in the steelmaking process to enhance properties like hardness, durability, and corrosion resistance. Additionally, it engages in the trading of manganese ore, a vital raw material for ferro alloy production. The company serves domestic and international steel industries and various foundry activities within the metallurgical sector, contributing to the global steel value chain.
